products.name: 2short.ai
products.note: YouTube shorts AI; clip extraction; content automation; platform dependency

profile_text.body:
2short is a web-based tool designed to help YouTube creators repurpose long-form video content into short clips suitable for platforms such as YouTube Shorts. The service describes itself as able to extract what it considers the most engaging moments from a video by analyzing spoken words and captions, and it requires that source videos have captions available, relying on YouTube's auto-generated captions where a creator has not provided their own.

The company's product, 2short.ai, is tracked in the Video Generation and Editing category. Features the site highlights include automated clip extraction, facial tracking technology to keep active speakers centered on screen, and support for over two dozen languages including English, Spanish, French, Japanese, and Korean, among others. Pricing plans are differentiated primarily by AI video analysis hours, and the site states a free Starter plan includes 15 minutes of AI video analysis.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the held facts for this company.
